source.description:
## PROBLEM
XT Codex parity needs xtmux-specific adapter work, but xtmux already owns messages, obligations, monitors, wakes, identity, lifecycle state, and recovery authorities.

## SUCCESS
Add a Codex runtime adapter, exact installed-version payload fixtures, stable turn capture, and recovery integration over existing xtmux domains. Produce a backward-compatible compatibility release before Core publishes the production launcher.

## SCOPE
This root owns only xtmux repository changes for K1 characterization, K3-xtmux, K4 lifecycle/distribution completion, test coverage, and the K6 sibling compatibility release.

## NON_GOALS
Do not create a Codex-specific message store, obligation store, monitor/wake registry, session identity, lifecycle authority, scheduler, launcher, worktree owner, or Specialist job system. Do not make optional MCP/plugin work or broad Serena history cleanup a prerequisite.

## CONSTRAINTS
Consume deterministic Core outcomes and exact argv next actions. Preserve current Pi/Claude behavior and public contracts. Use repository-local children only. Represent Core, Specialists, Jira, and programme gates as external references or companion relations.

## VALIDATION
Use real Codex payload fixtures, EVAL-01 Codex cases, restart/replay/idempotence tests, installer ownership tests, and an installed-package compatibility smoke. Prove existing state stores remain authoritative.

## OUTPUT
A repository-owned companion graph related to Core xtrm-ozknq and Jira KAN-127. Canonical sequencing note: https://github.com/xtrm-dev/xtrm/blob/ed06ba222307030c7153c43cd2370262706b78a4/docs/shared/xtrm-codex-kan-127-execution-note.md
